text: Seabrook Town build from their own half with Elias Haddad passing long to Callum Varga on the left side near the edge of the final third. Varga sends a cross to the right side where Tomas Kowalski controls and quickly lays a short pass to Kian Romano, positioned just three metres from Harbour City's goal at the far end. Romano takes the ball forward a step and fires a precise shot with his foot, scoring to extend Seabrook Town's lead to 4-2 in the final moments of the match[#1901][#1902][#1903][#1904][#1906].
